<edit path="specs/podcast-chapter-markers.md">
The spec as drafted: intent, goals, non-goals, constraints, approaches, the decided parts, and what's left to the builder, with the builder check's two answers folded in.
</edit>

This commit contains only the spec. I'm leaving `specs/deferred_items.md` unchanged because the chapter-markers entry is only done when chapters survive a transcode, and that hasn't happened yet. The item gets ticked when the plan built from this spec is completed.

**Commit message**

```
Add design spec for podcast chapter markers

Chapters uploaded as ID3 CHAP frames are lost on transcode. The design
stores chapters in the database, makes the episode editor the only
place to edit them, and writes them back into each transcoded file.

Resolves the storage decision for the chapter-markers item deferred
from 31-episode-feeds.
```

**Message to my partner**

> I've committed the spec at `specs/podcast-chapter-markers.md`. A reviewer read it first and asked two questions. We had already settled both in our conversation, so I added those answers to the document and have nothing new to ask you.
>
> Please read the committed file and tell me if anything is wrong or missing. Once you approve it, I'd suggest running `/clear` (or opening a new session) and running writing-plans against that file. The spec contains everything the plan needs, so you don't need this conversation for that step. The deferred item stays open until chapters actually survive a transcode.
